title: panic on `podman pull` at `docker_image_src.go:852`
body:
### Issue Description

I was running into #28813, so I was testing some workarounds, and I found an image that consistently causes Go panics when pulled as root, but pulls correctly when running rootless.

### Steps to reproduce the issue

```console
$ sudo podman --debug image pull --quiet --policy=always --retry=0 docker://maxchernoff.ca/fedora-bootc-base:causes-go-panic
```

### Describe the results you received

(too long; see [`podman-29277-1.txt`](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30369442/podman-29277-1.txt))

### Describe the results you expected

(too long; see [`podman-29277-2.txt`](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30369443/podman-29277-2.txt))

### Additional environment details

(too long; see [`podman-29277-3.txt`](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30369441/podman-29277-3.txt))

### Additional information

The image's source is available from https://github.com/gucci-on-fleek/maxchernoff.ca/blob/daa680ca/builder/containers/fedora-bootc-base/Containerfile and https://github.com/gucci-on-fleek/maxchernoff.ca/blob/daa680ca/usr/local/bin/build-container, and feel free to pull the image yourselves if you want. I'm also comfortable building Go programs from source if you want me to test anything.

comments.body:
If I comment out `use_composefs = "true"` in `/etc/containers/storage.conf`, the image successfully pulls with rootless v6.0.1:

(too long; see [`podman-29277-4.txt`](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30369487/podman-29277-4.txt))

~~But I get a _different_ error with rootfull v6.0.1:~~ _(this was a different, unrelated bug)_

~~(too long; see  [`podman-29277-5.txt`](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30369502/podman-29277-5.txt))~~

And rootfull is successful too, so the issue seems to be related to `use_composefs = "true"`.

Also, I'll add that I ran both `podman system reset` and `sudo podman system reset` once before starting all of these tests.
Hi! I'm interested in working on this issue.
